name: semantic-search
description: Semantic code search for the current project. Optional scan roots index ALL SOURCE CODE beneath those folders; cold searches can take minutes, unlike cheap cross-project NOTES scans in memory.

scan_root.title: Additional project root
scan_root.description: Optional folder to index ALL SOURCE CODE across its projects. A cold search can take minutes. Unlike memory, this is not a cheap cross-project NOTES scan. Leave empty for current-project-only search.

scan_root_2.title: Second additional project root
scan_root_2.description: Optional folder to index ALL SOURCE CODE across its projects. A cold search can take minutes. Unlike memory, this is not a cheap cross-project NOTES scan. Leave empty for current-project-only search.
